description.zh: 调用图片异步批量翻译接口获得的任务 ID
description.en: The task ID obtained by calling the asynchronous batch image translation API.

title.zh: 图片异步批量翻译结果获取
title.en: Retrieve asynchronous batch image translation results

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解图片翻译产品的[收费方式和价格](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163332.html)。

图片异步批量翻译的结果，翻译完毕后，会保存 1 小时，过期后会被清理，请及时获取结果。
descriptions.en:
Before using this API, review the image translation product's [billing methods and pricing](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163332.html).

Results of asynchronous batch image translation are saved for 1 hour after translation completes. They are cleared after expiration. Retrieve the results promptly.
